evidence_supports: The name 'Catasetum macrocarpum' with authorship 'Rich. ex Kunth' is recorded as an accepted species in the GBIF-backed canonical registry (canonical_id 19375).
Production record 27265 carries exactly that full name and authorship string.
Production record 46599 carries the bare name without authorship and is linked by the backbone crosswalk to public.taxonomy_species 1886 by crosswalk_id+canonical_name.
Both production records exist, both are rank species, both resolve to a dossier (HTTP 200), and both cite the same provenance source.
evidence_does_not_establish: That 46599 and 27265 denote the same taxon concept (duplicate records) rather than two distinct concepts sharing a name.
Which production record is canonical, or whether either should be retired, aliased or merged.
That a name-string match between 27265 and registry row 19375 is an identity link; the identifier spaces do not join.
What public.taxonomy_species 1886 denotes; it is not described anywhere in this repository.
That the registry snapshot is current, or that GBIF acceptance is Orchid Continuum's canonical decision; no other authority (e.g. WFO, WCVP, the Hassler/WorldOrchids release) is consulted here.
Which records (media, occurrences, literature, dossier sections) attached to either id belong to which concept.
unresolved_decision: A governed taxonomy reviewer must decide the canonical production identity for 'Catasetum macrocarpum' (keep both as distinct concepts, alias one to the other, or retire one), and how dependent records are re-pointed. This is a production taxonomy mutation and an owner/scientific gate.
why_review_required: More than one production record matches; the resolver's own contract reports ambiguity rather than choosing.
The strongest external evidence (registry row 19375) cannot be joined by identifier to either candidate; it supports a name string, not a record.
The two available links point in different directions: the authorship string matches 27265, while the only backbone crosswalk link belongs to 46599.
